events.text:
I removed the duplicate `procurement-ops@halcyon.example` entry from the notify list. That was the only cleanup the config needed.

I left `second_approval_threshold` at 9500. AP-7 requires a second approval at $10,000 or more, but it also lets procurement set stricter thresholds. Kwame Osei lowered it to 9500 on 2025-03-12 after audit finding IA-114 found purchases being split to stay under $10,000. Setting it back to 10000 would undo that control, so the config already complies with AP-7.

Everything else already matched the policy: the cost center manager is the first approver and the procurement lead is the second approver.
